description: agro run microvm. ADR #1575 (Accepted) sequences step 4: a microsandbox backend for untrusted steps. Spike mifunedev/agro#1555 added the `agro-msb` stage and pinned msb `v0.7.13`. The spike showed that the AGRO image boots under msb (`R05`, `R06`, `M01`, `M02` pass in 3 of 3 runs). The operator chose `agro-msb` as the default image, `sandbox` as the default user on every path, and tuning through usage. This host has `/dev/kvm` and `msb 0.7.13`, and the `kvm` group holds the `sandbox` user. `msb run` accepts a registry image or a local root filesystem, `-v SOURCE:DEST[:uid=N,gid=N]`, and `-w`.

userStories.title: msb probe on this host
userStories.description: As the advisor, I want one measured msb run of the `agro-msb` image on this host so that the target design rests on observed flags.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/tasks/agro-run-microvm/evidence/probe.md` records `msb --version` (`0.7.13`). The file also records a `/dev/kvm` open check for the `sandbox` user through the `kvm` group.
The probe builds `docker build --target agro-msb` locally and runs the image with `msb run`, from a registry or from an exported root filesystem. The probe records the method that works.
One run executes `sh -c 'id; pwd; exit 7'` with the worktree mounted at its host path. The transcript shows exit code 7, the guest user, and the working directory.
A file that the guest writes into the worktree has the host uid and gid on the host after the run. The probe records the mount options that achieve this result.
The probe records the boot-to-exit wall time for 3 runs, and `msb ls` shows no probe sandbox after the runs.
userStories.notes: Criterion-to-evidence (946b2450): msb 0.7.13 and /dev/kvm open via the kvm group: met; agro-msb built locally and run via docker save | msb load (rootfs export fails; plain-HTTP registry needs msb pull --insecure): met; sh -c "id; pwd; exit 7" with a host-path mount: exit 7, guest user sandbox (uid 1000), workdir correct: met (temp test dir, not the worktree); guest-written file owner 1001:1001 with no mount option under a primary-group sandbox login (sg kvm alone gives 1001:993): met with that condition; 3 runs 1370/1416/1386 ms, msb ls empty after msb rm --force: met. Caveat: guest-created files land as 600/700 on the host (mode in xattr).

userStories.title: Microvm execution target and the isolation flag
userStories.description: As a worker, I want `agro run --isolation microvm` so that an untrusted command runs in its own kernel.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/cli/src/lib/execution/microvm-target.ts` exports `MicrovmExecutionTarget` with `kind = "microvm"` that implements `ExecutionTarget` with the flags from US-001.
`agro run --isolation microvm -- <command...>` runs the command in that target, and the exit code passes through. `--isolation container` and no flag keep the current behavior.
The image order is `--image`, then `run.microvm.image` in `agro.json`, then the published `agro-msb` image for the CLI version.
Before the run, `agro run` checks that `msb --version` reports `0.7.13` and that `/dev/kvm` opens for read and write. A failed check exits 1 with a message that names the remedy.
After the command, and after a failure, `agro run` removes the sandbox (`msb rm --force`).
The fallback user name in `.agro/cli/src/lib/execution/ephemeral-target.ts` changes from `agro` to `sandbox`.
`--isolation microvm` with `run.services` or `access.egress: "allowlist"` exits 1 with a message that the combination is not supported yet.
Tests assert the exact `msb` argument vectors, the checks, the removal, and the refusals through a fake runner.
`pnpm typecheck` exits 0, and `pnpm test` through `agro run` shows no new failure against `evidence/baseline.md`.
userStories.notes: executed (advisor, a6b6b6ce, via agro run): typecheck 0; microvm-target + run + ephemeral-target + agro-config tests 176/176; fallback user sandbox. worker: full suite 1 baseline failure; real smoke with a local agro-msb image: agro run --isolation microvm printed sandbox and the worktree path, exit 7 in 2.1 s, msb ls empty after; kvm check refuses without the group; bad --isolation value is a usage error. Follow-up: the unused localImage option is removed in US-004.

userStories.title: The release publishes the agro-msb image
userStories.description: As an operator, I want each release to publish the `agro-msb` image so that the microVM mode of `agro run` has a default image.
acceptanceCriteria: `.github/workflows/release.yml` builds the `agro-msb` target from the released commit and pushes `ghcr.io/mifunedev/agro:<version>-msb` and `ghcr.io/mifunedev/agro:sha-<sha>-msb`.
The `agro-msb` push never moves the `latest` tag.
Existing release jobs and their order do not change, and the release tests in `.agro/scripts/__tests__/` pass.
userStories.notes: executed (advisor, merged 688cd512, via agro run): release-reservation and ci-workflow-contract tests pass. reasoned: new job publish-msb-image needs reserve and publish-image, skips on a no-op reservation, pushes <version>-msb and sha-<sha>-msb; no existing job needs it, so release finalization and latest promotion do not change; a test pins the two msb tags and the absence of latest.

userStories.title:
Usage log for tuning

- [ ] After each `--isolation microvm` run, `agro run` appends one JSON line to `${AGRO_HOME:-~/.agro}/runs/microvm.jsonl`. The line holds the time, the image reference, the image digest when known, the boot-to-exit milliseconds, and the exit code.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
userStories.description:
As an operator, I want the microVM mode documented so that a project knows when to use the mode.
- [ ] A failure to write the log prints one warning and does not change the exit code.
- [ ] Tests cover the line format and the write failure.

### US-005: Documentation and changelog

**Description:** As an operator, I want the microVM mode documented so that a project knows when to use it.
acceptanceCriteria: The `agro run` section of `docs/lifecycle-commands.md` describes `--isolation microvm`, the checks, the default image, `run.microvm.image`, the usage log, and the unsupported combinations.
`docs/runtimes/microsandbox.md` points to `agro run --isolation microvm`.
`CHANGELOG.md` holds one entry under `## [Unreleased]` that links the task issue.
userStories.notes: executed (advisor, c7f48bda, via agro run): typecheck 0; run + microvm-target tests 60/60; localImage and --pull never removed (0 references). worker: full suite 1 baseline failure; tests cover the line format, default path with digest null, write-failure warning keeping exit 7, and no line when the command never starts. Real log write checked in US-006.

userStories.title: Validation
userStories.description: As the operator, I want proof that the microVM mode works on this host so that ADR #1575 step 4 meets its validation rule.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/tasks/agro-run-microvm/evidence/manual-review.md` records `agro run --isolation microvm -- sh -c 'id; exit 7'` from the harness root, with exit code 7 and the guest user `sandbox`.
The transcript records `agro run --isolation microvm -- pnpm --version` and the boot-to-exit time next to the same command under the container mode.
The transcript shows that the guest cannot read the host home directory and cannot reach the host Docker socket.
After the runs, `msb ls` shows no `agro-run-` sandbox, and `microvm.jsonl` holds one line for each run.
userStories.notes: Criterion-to-evidence (merged ed5ee277; local agro-msb image because -msb ships at the next release; runs via sg kvm): id; exit 7 -> exit 7, uid=1000(sandbox): met; pnpm --version microVM median 4817 ms vs container 1514 ms, recorded: met; guest sees only the mounted path under the host home, and no Docker socket: met; msb ls empty after and microvm.jsonl holds one line per run (7 lines): met (advisor rechecked msb ls and image ls empty).
